This mission is similar to [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/House Party|House Party]], in the sense that it consists of two parts which can be completed separately.

==Part 1==
After the cutscene, just drive to Jizzy's club [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Jizzy.png]] to trigger part 2.

==Part 2==
After the cutscene, you must drive the pimpmobile to a hotel in Downtown. Then you have two minutes to kill a pimp in Hashbury. After that you must save one of Jizzy's girls from being killed. Drive quickly to the yellow blip in Foster Valley, which is '''under''' the freeway. Finally, you must head back to the hotel in Downtown, and chase and destroy two vehicles traveling to Angel Pine to complete the mission. You end the mission with a 2-star wanted level.

== Tips ==
* If you destroy the preachers car before the bodyguard, the bodyguard will get out of his car, making it slightly easier.
* If you prefer to drive-by just use the SMG for bigger damage
* Before you trigger the limo to drive at high speed, take a side road to get ahead of the convoy. Stand in road as cars approach (still at usual traffic speed). Use your biggest weapon of choice (rocket launcher if possible) and blast the limo. The 2 bodyguards will get out the car, shoot them dead and mission accomplished, with no high speed pursuit at all and no drive-by shooting required.

== Rewards ==
* '''Cash''': $3,000
* '''Respect''': +20
